keyStoredLocally: Your key is encrypted locally in this browser.
serverDefaultProviderDesc: This provider is the backend Server Default admin config. Name, base URL, models, and key are saved on the backend; the key is never returned to the browser.
serverManagedProviderDesc: This provider is managed by the backend. Its name, base URL, models, and key persist across refreshes and browsers; the key is never returned to the browser.
errorFetchingModels: Error fetching models. Please check Base URL and API Key.
providerActivated: Provider connection passed and is now enabled.
activationFailed: Activation failed. Check the Base URL and API Key.
keyStoredOnServer: The key is BYOK-encrypted and stored on the backend; plaintext is not stored in the browser.
